final_answer: BR could not provide this number. BR-KG holds only one ABIDE node ('ABIDE (I & II)', kg_id ds:manual:abide) with a single aggregate subjects_count of 2226 across ABIDE I and ABIDE II combined, no per-diagnosis (ASD vs control) split, no CC200/CPAC-pipeline node, no phenotype-file node, and no motion/QC-threshold value attached to ABIDE. Neither source paper (Di Martino et al. 2014, doi:10.1038/mp.2013.78; Abraham et al. 2017, doi:10.1016/j.neuroimage.2016.10.045) exists as a Publication node in BR-KG (kg_get_node: 'node not found' for both DOIs), and kg_method_condition_coverage_guard returned 'publication_not_found' for both, so BR cannot resolve Abraham et al.'s actual QC/motion threshold or sample size either. kg_multihop_qa timed out/degraded on the direct question and its partial traversal drifted to unrelated 'Motor Control' concept nodes, confirming no KG path encodes this fact. No BR tool call returned a QC-passing N, nor a diagnosis breakdown, for ABIDE I under any functional-QC definition.

evidence.claim: ABIDE is represented in BR-KG as a single combined dataset node with 2226 total subjects (ABIDE I + II), no diagnosis or QC breakdown.
Di Martino et al. 2014 (doi:10.1038/mp.2013.78) is not a node in BR-KG.
Abraham et al. 2017 (doi:10.1016/j.neuroimage.2016.10.045) is not a node in BR-KG.
BR's dedicated method-condition resolver also cannot find either paper, so it cannot surface Abraham et al.'s QC/cohort parameters from any backend tier.
No BR-KG edge connects the ABIDE dataset node to a CC200 atlas/pipeline, a phenotype file, or a motion/QC threshold node.
A generic Framewise Displacement concept node exists in BR-KG but carries no ABIDE-specific threshold value or linkage.
evidence.source: kg_search_nodes 'mean framewise displacement ... CPAC filt_noglobal' -> concept:framewise_displacement

br_limitations: BR-KG has no participant-level data at all (no per-subject rows, no phenotype CSV join, no ABIDE I vs ABIDE II split, no diagnosis field), no ingested node for either source publication (Di Martino 2014 or Abraham 2017), no CC200/CPAC-pipeline derivative node, and no QC/motion-threshold value tied to ABIDE. dataset_get_resources confirms the dataset is not locally mounted through BR, so it cannot even enumerate derivative files (e.g., CC200 ROI time series or Phenotypic_V1_0b_preprocessed1.csv) to count rows. kg_multihop_qa could not route to anything ABIDE-QC-relevant and degraded on budget. In short: BR can identify that ABIDE exists and has ~2226 total subjects, but cannot answer any question requiring the actual phenotype table, the CC200/QC pipeline specifics, or a diagnosis-stratified post-QC count.
